𝓟𝓮𝓻𝓼𝓸𝓷𝓪𝓵𝓲𝓽𝔂:She is an extremely vain girl who tends to over-worry and believes herself to be the most beautiful girl in school. When Mal gave other girls' makeovers, she was upset, not because she believed Mal was up to something but because she didn't want anyone to rival her in appearance.

She was immediately uncomfortable with the idea of VKs coming, often criticized them in private and in front of them. She believes that they’re evil due to their parents villainous acts without giving them a chance. She not only acts mean to the VKs, but to a few others as well, being very demanding and demeaning such as laughing at Jane over her ugly hair and preferring to be the center of attention. She hates looking imperfect and enjoys competition and taking selfies.

Even after accepting the VKs, she remained jealous of them because they were getting all the attention she's used to getting, and has trouble trying to figure them out. She even disliked it when Evie won being Q.N.L.B. instead of herself and became suspicious of them when CJ committed a series of crimes around Auradon. She's quick to frame Mal for it, even blaming her when Ben started going missing.

Despite this, she does show a strong sense of morality, as she refused to steal on the Isle of the Lost and even offered to help pay for a cup Ben broke to prove the two could be bad, worriedly asking if they were going to go to jail. In addition, she does care about her friends, even though she comes off as rude. In most cases though, she is uptight and no-nonsense, having little patience for others' antics. This is taken further when she planned the Jewel-bilee for the 5 VKs as a gift to their friendship and felt guilty for being unfair to Mal out over a misunderstanding.

Audrey is the daughter of aurora aka sleeping beauty, she had a boyfriend named Ben and he was the son of belle and beast 

I do honestly see where Queen Leah is coming from in the first film. I mean she sees this girl who is the spitting image of the woman who took her daughter away from her and she immediately goes on the defensive, however right or wrong that may be she just couldn’t take the chance to lose her granddaughter like she lost her daughter. It’s even ok that she held a grudge after finding out that Mal wasn’t Maleficent because I can understand being wary of someone that was raised to be a villain. It is the fact that she continues to hold distain for Mal and the VK’s (when there has already been 2 movies of them demonstrating that they can be and are good) that makes her a very unsympathetic character. Her closeness to Audrey seems to be an effort to make up for her lack of closeness to Aurora throughout her childhood and I think Queen Leah feels extreme guilt and sadness and frustration at not being able to be a true mother to Aurora. That’s why with Audrey she is going for gold. She wants Audrey’s life to be the perfect life Aurora never got.

So maybe she orchestrates the betrothal of Ben and Audrey when they are kids because if she had had Aurora when she was a child then Aurora would also likely of had a match made for her in childhood in order to better her nation. When she snaps at Audrey that Aurora could keep a Prince in her sleep it could be misdirected aggression-Audrey isn’t failing, it’s Leah’s plan for Audrey’s perfect life that is falling to pieces and because of a girl who looks exactly like the woman who ruined Leah’s life. History is repeating itself and Leah punishes Audrey for it in the heat of the moment because what are the chances Leah’s perfect dream for her descendants would fail twice? It can’t be her, it must be someone else. Mal,Ben or even Audrey. But it is Leah’s fault. And likely also Aurora’s for not stepping in and telling her daughter that love shouldn’t be about power and keeping appearances. Love should be true. Leah made Audrey view Love as this organised predetermined thing that can be decided upon and arranged. Mal and Ben represent chaotic and unplanned love. Love based around the actual person and not the idea of them. Trying to be an ideal princess tore Mal apart in D2 but she only acted like that for a few months. Audrey has been keeping up appearances her entire life-no wonder she snapped when her carefully constructed happily ever after collapsed.

Ironically Leah and Audrey’s story parallels Maleficent and Mal’s-the idea of controlling the destiny of their child/grandchild. In controlling/influencing Audrey, Leah has become the very woman she hates except instead of trapping someone in tower of thorns in a sleeping curse, Leah has Audrey mentally trapped into the belief that you can plan your happily ever after when the very thing that the tales of the older Disney characters shows us is that you can’t force a happily ever after. She’s trapped Audrey in the belief that she isn’t good enough unless she wins the prince, unless she becomes Queen and raises their family standing when in reality she should have been teaching her to love herself and be genuinely good to the core.

Audrey is an extremely vain girl who tends to over-worry and believes herself to be the most beautiful girl in school. When Mal gave other girls makeovers, she was upset, not because she believed Mal was up to something but because she didn't want anyone to rival her in appearance.

She was immediately uncomfortable with the idea of VKs coming, often criticizing them in private and in front of them. She believes that they're evil due to their parents' villainous acts without giving them a chance. She not only acts mean to the VKs, but to a few others as well, being very demanding and demeaning such as laughing at Jane over her ugly hair and preferring to be the center of attention. She hates looking imperfect and enjoys competition and taking selfies.

Even after accepting the VKs, she remained jealous of them because they were getting all the attention she's used to getting and having trouble trying to figure them out. She even disliked it when Evie won being Q.N.L.B. instead of herself and became suspicious of them when CJ committed a series of crimes around Auradon. She's quick to frame Mal for it, even blaming her when Ben started going missing.

Despite this, she does show a strong sense of morality, as she refused to steal on the Isle of the Lost in Episode 5 and even offered to help pay for a cup that Ben broke to prove the two could be bad, worriedly asking if they were going to go to jail. In addition, she does care about her friends, even though she comes off as rude. In most cases though, she is uptight and no-nonsense, having little patience for others' antics. This is taken further when she planned the Jewel-bile for the 5 VKs as a gift to their friendship and felt guilty for being unfair to Mal out over a misunderstanding.

Despite her vanity, Audrey has a great deal of empathy lying under the surface. After being released from the hold Maleficent's staff had on her and being awakened from her enchanted sleep by Hades, she was truly horrified by what she had done while under the influence of the staff, sincerely apologizing to Mal and Ben for everything she did to them.
